notes: The *have* of the verbless possessive clause is placed on the `לְ` under rule 43, since no `הָיָה` and no existential particle stands in the verse; the suffix takes the subject pronoun *he* (rules 40, 43).
`כֹּל` keeps a bare *all* and `אֵלֶּה` its own *these*: the ASV writes no *of* between them, so rule 19's quantifying-construct *of* does not arise.
The copula of the second clause joins the predicate noun `בְּנֵי` under rule 20, with the construct's supplied *the* under rule 29.
